text:
You're not boring. You're leaking your power.

All that energy belongs in your voice. Your handshake. The way you carry yourself.

The men who fill rooms aren't trying harder. They stopped draining it into p0rn and screens.

S*x drive pointed outward is what people call charisma. It's contagious. Rooms feel it.

Cut one drain tonight. Move like you mean it. Talk like every word costs something.

Charisma isn't born. It's what's left when you stop wasting yourself.
caption:
The thing everyone calls charisma is energy that was never wasted. Discipline is where self improvement starts.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
